title: listings.moderation_content
description: Content of one listing for moderation screening and the moderator's card. The moderation bus carries identifiers only; the content travels over this authorized call, so it is read fresh at screening time instead of decaying in an event payload. Answers {listing_id, text, title, language, media, author_id, url, status, moderation_status}. Raises LookupError for an unknown listing.

listing_id.description: Primary key of the listing whose content is being moderated.
